verses.text_uthmani: الٓر ۚ تِلْكَ ءَايَـٰتُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ وَقُرْءَانٍ مُّبِينٍ

translations.text: Alif Lam Ra These are the verses of the Scripture, a Quran that makes things clear.

verses.text_uthmani: رُّبَمَا يَوَدُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ مُسْلِمِينَ

translations.text: The disbelievers may well come to wish they had submitted to God,

verses.text_uthmani: ذَرْهُمْ يَأْكُلُوا۟ وَيَتَمَتَّعُوا۟ وَيُلْهِهِمُ ٱلْأَمَلُ ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ

translations.text: so [Prophet] leave them to eat and enjoy themselves. Let [false] hopes distract them: they will come to know.

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا وَلَهَا كِتَابٌ مَّعْلُومٌ

translations.text: Never have We destroyed a community that did not have a set time;

verses.text_uthmani: مَّا تَسْبِقُ مِنْ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسْتَـْٔخِرُونَ

translations.text: no community can bring its time forward, nor delay it.

verses.text_uthmani: وَقَالُوا۟ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِى نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلذِّكْرُ إِنَّكَ لَمَجْنُونٌ

translations.text: They say, ‘Receiver of this Quran! You are definitely mad.

verses.text_uthmani: لَّوْ مَا تَأْتِينَا بِٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ

translations.text: Why do you not bring us the angels, if you are telling the truth?’

verses.text_uthmani: مَا نُنَزِّلُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَمَا كَانُوٓا۟ إِذًا مُّنظَرِينَ

translations.text: But We send down the angels only to bring justice and then these people will not be reprieved.

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا ٱلذِّكْرَ وَإِنَّا لَهُۥ لَحَـٰفِظُونَ

translations.text: We have sent down the Quran Ourself, and We Ourself will guard it. Even before you [Prophet],

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ فِى شِيَعِ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

translations.text: We sent messengers among the various communities of old,

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ

translations.text: but they mocked every single messenger that came to them:

verses.text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ نَسْلُكُهُۥ فِى قُلُوبِ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ

translations.text: in this way We make the message slip through the hearts of evildoers.

verses.text_uthmani: لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ ۖ وَقَدْ خَلَتْ سُنَّةُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

translations.text: They will not believe in it. That was what happened with the peoples of long ago,

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَوْ فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِم بَابًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَظَلُّوا۟ فِيهِ يَعْرُجُونَ

translations.text: and even if We opened a gateway into Heaven for them and they rose through it, higher and higher,

verses.text_uthmani: لَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَا سُكِّرَتْ أَبْصَـٰرُنَا بَلْ نَحْنُ قَوْمٌ مَّسْحُورُونَ

translations.text: they would still say, ‘Our eyes are hallucinating. We are bewitched.’

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ جَعَلْنَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ بُرُوجًا وَزَيَّنَّـٰهَا لِلنَّـٰظِرِينَ

translations.text: We have set constellations up in the sky and made it beautiful for all to see,

verses.text_uthmani: وَحَفِظْنَـٰهَا مِن كُلِّ شَيْطَـٰنٍ رَّجِيمٍ

translations.text: and guarded it from every stoned satan:

verses.text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَنِ ٱسْتَرَقَ ٱلسَّمْعَ فَأَتْبَعَهُۥ شِهَابٌ مُّبِينٌ

translations.text: any eavesdropper will be pursued by a clearly visible flame.

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱلْأَرْضَ مَدَدْنَـٰهَا وَأَلْقَيْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ وَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍ مَّوْزُونٍ

translations.text: As for the earth, We have spread it out, set firm mountains on it, and made everything grow there in due balance.

verses.text_uthmani: وَجَعَلْنَا لَكُمْ فِيهَا مَعَـٰيِشَ وَمَن لَّسْتُمْ لَهُۥ بِرَٰزِقِينَ

translations.text: We have provided sustenance in it for you and for all those creatures for whom you do not provide.

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِن مِّن شَىْءٍ إِلَّا عِندَنَا خَزَآئِنُهُۥ وَمَا نُنَزِّلُهُۥٓ إِلَّا بِقَدَرٍ مَّعْلُومٍ

translations.text: There is not a thing whose storehouses are not with Us. We send it down only according to a well-defined measure:

verses.text_uthmani: وَأَرْسَلْنَا ٱلرِّيَـٰحَ لَوَٰقِحَ فَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَأَسْقَيْنَـٰكُمُوهُ وَمَآ أَنتُمْ لَهُۥ بِخَـٰزِنِينَ

translations.text: We send the winds to fertilize, and We bring down water from the sky for you to drink- you do not control its sources.

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ نُحْىِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَنَحْنُ ٱلْوَٰرِثُونَ

translations.text: It is We who give life and death; it is We who inherit [everything].

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا ٱلْمُسْتَقْدِمِينَ مِنكُمْ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا ٱلْمُسْتَـْٔخِرِينَ

translations.text: We know exactly those of you who come first and those who come later.

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ حَكِيمٌ عَلِيمٌ

translations.text: [Prophet], it is your Lord who will gather them all together: He is all wise, all knowing.

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ مِن صَلْصَـٰلٍ مِّنْ حَمَإٍ مَّسْنُونٍ

translations.text: We created man out of dried clay formed from dark mud-

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱلْجَآنَّ خَلَقْنَـٰهُ مِن قَبْلُ مِن نَّارِ ٱلسَّمُومِ

translations.text: the jinn We created before, from the fire of scorching wind.

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّى خَـٰلِقٌۢ بَشَرًا مِّن صَلْصَـٰلٍ مِّنْ حَمَإٍ مَّسْنُونٍ

translations.text: Your Lord said to the angels, ‘I will create a mortal out of dried clay, formed from dark mud.

verses.text_uthmani: فَإِذَا سَوَّيْتُهُۥ وَنَفَخْتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِى فَقَعُوا۟ لَهُۥ سَـٰجِدِينَ

translations.text: When I have fashioned him and breathed My spirit into him, bow down before him,’

verses.text_uthmani: فَسَجَدَ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ أَجْمَعُونَ

translations.text: and the angels all did so.

verses.text_uthmani: إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ أَبَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونَ مَعَ ٱلسَّـٰجِدِينَ

translations.text: But not Iblis: he refused to bow down like the others.

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ يَـٰٓإِبْلِيسُ مَا لَكَ أَلَّا تَكُونَ مَعَ ٱلسَّـٰجِدِينَ

translations.text: God said, ‘Iblis, why did you not bow down like the others?’

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ لَمْ أَكُن لِّأَسْجُدَ لِبَشَرٍ خَلَقْتَهُۥ مِن صَلْصَـٰلٍ مِّنْ حَمَإٍ مَّسْنُونٍ

translations.text: and he answered, ‘I will not bow to a mortal You created from dried clay, formed from dark mud.’

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ فَٱخْرُجْ مِنْهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٌ

translations.text: ‘Get out of here!’ said God. ‘You are an outcast,

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكَ ٱللَّعْنَةَ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ

translations.text: rejected until the Day of Judgement.’

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرْنِىٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ

translations.text: Iblis said, ‘My Lord, give me respite until the Day when they are raised from the dead.’

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنظَرِينَ

translations.text: ‘You have respite,’ said God,

verses.text_uthmani: إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْوَقْتِ ٱلْمَعْلُومِ

translations.text: ‘until the Day of the Appointed Time.’

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَآ أَغْوَيْتَنِى لَأُزَيِّنَنَّ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ

translations.text: Iblis then said to God, ‘Because You have put me in the wrong, I will lure mankind on earth and put them in the wrong,

verses.text_uthmani: إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ

translations.text: all except Your devoted servants.’

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ هَـٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ عَلَىَّ مُسْتَقِيمٌ

translations.text: God said, ‘[Devotion] is a straight path to Me:

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ عِبَادِى لَيْسَ لَكَ عَلَيْهِمْ سُلْطَـٰنٌ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلْغَاوِينَ

translations.text: you will have no power over My servants, only over the ones who go astray and follow you.

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ لَمَوْعِدُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ

translations.text: Hell is the promised place for all these,

verses.text_uthmani: لَهَا سَبْعَةُ أَبْوَٰبٍ لِّكُلِّ بَابٍ مِّنْهُمْ جُزْءٌ مَّقْسُومٌ

translations.text: with seven gates, each gate having its allotted share of them.

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ

translations.text: But the righteous will be in Gardens with springs-

verses.text_uthmani: ٱدْخُلُوهَا بِسَلَـٰمٍ ءَامِنِينَ

translations.text: “Enter them in peace and safety!”––

verses.text_uthmani: وَنَزَعْنَا مَا فِى صُدُورِهِم مِّنْ غِلٍّ إِخْوَٰنًا عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍ مُّتَقَـٰبِلِينَ

translations.text: and We shall remove any bitterness from their hearts: [they will be like] brothers, sitting on couches, face to face.

verses.text_uthmani: لَا يَمَسُّهُمْ فِيهَا نَصَبٌ وَمَا هُم مِّنْهَا بِمُخْرَجِينَ

translations.text: No weariness will ever touch them there, nor will they ever be expelled.’

verses.text_uthmani: ۞ نَبِّئْ عِبَادِىٓ أَنِّىٓ أَنَا ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ

translations.text: [Prophet], tell My servants that I am the Forgiving, the Merciful,

verses.text_uthmani: وَأَنَّ عَذَابِى هُوَ ٱلْعَذَابُ ٱلْأَلِيمُ

translations.text: but My torment is the truly painful one.

verses.text_uthmani: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ عَن ضَيْفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ

translations.text: Tell them too about Abraham’s guests:

verses.text_uthmani: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوا۟ سَلَـٰمًا قَالَ إِنَّا مِنكُمْ وَجِلُونَ

translations.text: when they came to him and said, ‘Peace,’ he said, ‘We are afraid of you.’

verses.text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ لَا تَوْجَلْ إِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلَـٰمٍ عَلِيمٍ

translations.text: ‘Do not be afraid,’ they said, ‘We bring you good news of a son who will have great knowledge.’

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ أَبَشَّرْتُمُونِى عَلَىٰٓ أَن مَّسَّنِىَ ٱلْكِبَرُ فَبِمَ تُبَشِّرُونَ

translations.text: He said, ‘How can you give me such news when old age has come to me? What sort of news is this?’

verses.text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ بَشَّرْنَـٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ فَلَا تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْقَـٰنِطِينَ

translations.text: They said, ‘We have told you the truth, so do not despair.’

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ وَمَن يَقْنَطُ مِن رَّحْمَةِ رَبِّهِۦٓ إِلَّا ٱلضَّآلُّونَ

translations.text: He said, ‘Who but the misguided despair of the mercy of their Lord?’

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ

translations.text: and then asked, ‘Messengers, what is your errand?’

verses.text_uthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ أُرْسِلْنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍ مُّجْرِمِينَ

translations.text: They replied, ‘We have been sent to a people who are guilty.’

verses.text_uthmani: إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍ إِنَّا لَمُنَجُّوهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ

translations.text: But We shall save the household of Lot,

verses.text_uthmani: إِلَّا ٱمْرَأَتَهُۥ قَدَّرْنَآ ۙ إِنَّهَا لَمِنَ ٱلْغَـٰبِرِينَ

translations.text: all except his wife: We have decreed that she will be one of those who stay behind.

verses.text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ءَالَ لُوطٍ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ

translations.text: When the messengers came to the household of Lot,

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ إِنَّكُمْ قَوْمٌ مُّنكَرُونَ

translations.text: he said, ‘You are strangers.’

verses.text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ بَلْ جِئْنَـٰكَ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ فِيهِ يَمْتَرُونَ

translations.text: They said, ‘We have brought you what they said would never happen:

verses.text_uthmani: وَأَتَيْنَـٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَإِنَّا لَصَـٰدِقُونَ

translations.text: we have brought you the Truth. We speak truly,

verses.text_uthmani: فَأَسْرِ بِأَهْلِكَ بِقِطْعٍ مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱتَّبِعْ أَدْبَـٰرَهُمْ وَلَا يَلْتَفِتْ مِنكُمْ أَحَدٌ وَٱمْضُوا۟ حَيْثُ تُؤْمَرُونَ

translations.text: so leave in the dead of the night with your household, and walk behind them. Let none of you look back. Go where you are commanded.’

verses.text_uthmani: وَقَضَيْنَآ إِلَيْهِ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْأَمْرَ أَنَّ دَابِرَ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ مَقْطُوعٌ مُّصْبِحِينَ

translations.text: We made this decree known to him: the last remnants of those people would be wiped out in the morning.

verses.text_uthmani: وَجَآءَ أَهْلُ ٱلْمَدِينَةِ يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ

translations.text: The people of the town came along, revelling,

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ ضَيْفِى فَلَا تَفْضَحُونِ

translations.text: and he told them, ‘These are my guests, do not disgrace me.

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَلَا تُخْزُونِ

translations.text: Fear God, and do not shame me.’

verses.text_uthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ أَوَلَمْ نَنْهَكَ عَنِ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

translations.text: They answered, ‘Have we not told you not to interfere [between us and] anyone else?’

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ بَنَاتِىٓ إِن كُنتُمْ فَـٰعِلِينَ

translations.text: He said, ‘My daughters are here, if you must.’

verses.text_uthmani: لَعَمْرُكَ إِنَّهُمْ لَفِى سَكْرَتِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ

translations.text: By your life [Prophet], they wandered on in their wild intoxication

verses.text_uthmani: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ مُشْرِقِينَ

translations.text: and the blast overtook them at sunrise:

verses.text_uthmani: فَجَعَلْنَا عَـٰلِيَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةً مِّن سِجِّيلٍ

translations.text: We turned their city upside down and rained on them a shower of clay stones.

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّلْمُتَوَسِّمِينَ

translations.text: There truly is a sign in this for those who can learn-

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهَا لَبِسَبِيلٍ مُّقِيمٍ

translations.text: it is still there on the highway-

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

translations.text: there truly is a sign in this for those who believe.

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِن كَانَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْأَيْكَةِ لَظَـٰلِمِينَ

translations.text: The forest-dwellers, too, were wrongdoers

verses.text_uthmani: فَٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ وَإِنَّهُمَا لَبِإِمَامٍ مُّبِينٍ

translations.text: and We took retribution on them; both are still there on the highway, plain for all to see.

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ كَذَّبَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْحِجْرِ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ

translations.text: The people of al-Hijr also rejected Our messengers:

verses.text_uthmani: وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُمْ ءَايَـٰتِنَا فَكَانُوا۟ عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ

translations.text: We gave them Our signs, but they turned their backs.

verses.text_uthmani: وَكَانُوا۟ يَنْحِتُونَ مِنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا ءَامِنِينَ

translations.text: They carved out dwellings in the mountains, and lived in security-

verses.text_uthmani: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ مُصْبِحِينَ

translations.text: the blast overwhelmed them early in the morning.

verses.text_uthmani: فَمَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ

translations.text: What they had gained was of no use to them.

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ ۗ وَإِنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ لَـَٔاتِيَةٌ ۖ فَٱصْفَحِ ٱلصَّفْحَ ٱلْجَمِيلَ

translations.text: We did not create the heavens and the earth and everything between them without a true purpose: the Hour will certainly come, so [Prophet] bear with them graciously.

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ ٱلْخَلَّـٰقُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ

translations.text: Your Lord is the All Knowing Creator.

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَـٰكَ سَبْعًا مِّنَ ٱلْمَثَانِى وَٱلْقُرْءَانَ ٱلْعَظِيمَ

translations.text: We have given you the seven oft-recited verses and the whole glorious Quran.

verses.text_uthmani: لَا تَمُدَّنَّ عَيْنَيْكَ إِلَىٰ مَا مَتَّعْنَا بِهِۦٓ أَزْوَٰجًا مِّنْهُمْ وَلَا تَحْزَنْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَٱخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

translations.text: Do not look longingly at the good things We have given some to enjoy. Do not grieve over the [disbelievers], but lower your wings over the believers

verses.text_uthmani: وَقُلْ إِنِّىٓ أَنَا ٱلنَّذِيرُ ٱلْمُبِينُ

translations.text: and say, ‘I am here to give plain warning,’

verses.text_uthmani: كَمَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَى ٱلْمُقْتَسِمِينَ

translations.text: like the [warning] We have sent down for those who divide themselves into bands

verses.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ جَعَلُوا۟ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ عِضِينَ

translations.text: and abuse the Quran––

verses.text_uthmani: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَسْـَٔلَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ

translations.text: by your Lord, We will question them all

verses.text_uthmani: عَمَّا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ

translations.text: about their deeds.

verses.text_uthmani: فَٱصْدَعْ بِمَا تُؤْمَرُ وَأَعْرِضْ عَنِ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ

translations.text: So proclaim openly what you have been commanded [to say], and ignore the idolaters.

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّا كَفَيْنَـٰكَ ٱلْمُسْتَهْزِءِينَ

translations.text: We are enough for you against all those who ridicule your message,

verses.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ يَجْعَلُونَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ ۚ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ

translations.text: who set up another god beside God- they will come to know.

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ نَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ يَضِيقُ صَدْرُكَ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ

translations.text: We are well aware that your heart is weighed down by what they say.

verses.text_uthmani: فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَكُن مِّنَ ٱلسَّـٰجِدِينَ

translations.text: Celebrate the glory of your Lord and be among those who bow down to Him:

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱعْبُدْ رَبَّكَ حَتَّىٰ يَأْتِيَكَ ٱلْيَقِينُ

translations.text: worship your Lord until what is certain comes to you.
